description:
Annual tuition fee history for international schools in Thailand: 455 school-year records covering 99 schools, spanning the 2017/18 to 2025/26 academic years and concentrated in 2019/20-2024/25. Each row gives the lowest and highest published annual tuition figures (nominal Thai baht) for one school in one academic year, the basis on which the figure was published (range, single figure, or per-grade table), a provenance label, and a link to the archived source it was read from.

Every figure was read from an archived (Wayback Machine) copy of a published source. Provenance labels follow CredRadar's site-wide convention: [O] Official fees (source_type = wayback-official, 42 records) - fee taken from the school's own published fee document; [A] Aggregator figure (source_type = wayback-isd, 413 records) - fee as listed by a third-party aggregator (e.g. ISD, Edarabia); not the school's own published figure - confirm with the school. Only figures actually published in an archived source are included: no interpolation, no estimates. Where an official per-grade table and an aggregator figure both existed for the same school-year, the official figure replaces the aggregator figure.

Headline finding from the canonical report: on a like-for-like basis (the same 42 Bangkok schools with published fees in both 2020/21 and 2024/25), the median fee rose +13.7% over four years, about +3.3% per year.

Coverage caveat: this dataset covers the international-school segment only, not all Thai private K-12 education. Absence of a school or year means no figure could be verified, not that the fee was zero or unchanged. Caveat for 2019/20: the aggregator published a single figure per school that year (basis = single figure, stored as min = max); do not treat those rows as ranges.

Columns: school_slug (CredRadar's stable school identifier, matching the school page URL on credradar.org), school_name, academic_year, fee_min_thb, fee_max_thb (nominal THB, no inflation or currency adjustment), basis, source_type, source_url (archived snapshot the figure was read from), snapshot_date.

Published by CredRadar (https://credradar.org). Canonical report: https://credradar.org/reports/thailand-international-school-fees/

Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 - attribution required, non-commercial use only.
subtitle: 455 verified school-year tuition records for 99 international schools in Thailand, recovered from archived published fee documents and listings.
title: Thailand International School Fee History (2020/21-2024/25)
